summary: Rectangular black stepper driver carrier PCB, 1.0 in x 1.4 in. A driver IC sits in the middle of the top face, with two electrolytic capacitors near one short end. Through-holes run along the board edges, and there are two larger mounting holes on one long side.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat underside of the PCB, usable as the seating face when the board is mounted on standoffs through the two mounting holes.
Top face of the PCB, which carries the driver IC, capacitors and trimmer potentiometer. It is not flat because of these components.

notes: The 25.4 mm x 35.56 mm footprint comes from the printed 1.0 in x 1.4 in dimensions. The z value of 1.6 mm is an assumed bare-PCB thickness, since no height is given. The tallest components, the two capacitors, are not included, so the overall height would be larger. The mounting-hole diameter (2.2 mm) is an estimate and is not stated. The hole positions were scaled from the top-view image, with x across the short side and y along the long side, and are approximate. The edge pin/through-hole rows and the larger power-terminal holes are visible, but their diameters are not stated, so they are left out of the holes list. The pin rows follow roughly a 2.54 mm pitch, which is assumed from the layout.
